moments.title: Premier League Season Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season officially begins on Friday, August 21st, with Arsenal facing newly promoted Coventry City, marking the start of a new campaign.

angles.name: Kick-off excitement
angles.copy: It's almost here! The Premier League returns on August 21st with Arsenal taking on Coventry City. Who are you backing for the opening weekend?

angles.name: Team focus
angles.copy: Coventry City are back in the big time! Their Premier League journey starts against Arsenal on August 21st. Can they cause an upset?

angles.name: Fantasy Football prep
angles.copy: Only two weeks until the Premier League kicks off! Your fantasy football team needs to be ready. Who's your must-have player this season?

moments.title: Community Shield Showdown in Cardiff
moments.blurb: The FA Community Shield sees Premier League champions Arsenal take on FA Cup holders Manchester City on Sunday, August 16th, at the Principality Stadium in Cardiff.

angles.name: Cardiff host
angles.copy: Cardiff is hosting the Community Shield! Arsenal vs Man City at the Principality Stadium this Sunday, August 16th. Who's lifting the first silverware of the season?

angles.name: Welsh pride
angles.copy: The Principality Stadium welcomes two giants of English football this Sunday for the Community Shield! Get ready for Arsenal vs Man City in Cardiff.

angles.name: Season opener
angles.copy: Arsenal vs Man City – a taste of the Premier League rivalry to come! The Community Shield kicks off the season on August 16th.

moments.title: The Hundred Finals Day at Lord's
moments.blurb: The culmination of The Hundred 2026 season arrives on Sunday, August 16th, with both the men's and women's finals taking place at Lord's Cricket Ground.

angles.name: Cricket excitement
angles.copy: It's Finals Day for The Hundred this Sunday! Who will be crowned champions at Lord's? Get ready for some explosive cricket action.

angles.name: Lord's atmosphere
angles.copy: Lord's will be buzzing this Sunday for The Hundred Finals! The best of men's and women's cricket battle it out for the title.

angles.name: Team support
angles.copy: Your team in The Hundred – are they making it to the finals at Lord's this Sunday? Who are you rooting for?

moments.title: Boardmasters Festival Wraps Up
moments.blurb: Boardmasters Festival, combining surf, skate, and music, concludes today, August 7th, in Newquay, Cornwall, after five days of events and performances.

angles.name: Festival memories
angles.copy: That's a wrap on Boardmasters 2026! What were your favourite moments from Newquay? The waves, the music, or both?

angles.name: Cornwall vibes
angles.copy: Another incredible Boardmasters in the books! The Cornish coast came alive with music and surf. Who's already planning for next year?

angles.name: Music highlights
angles.copy: From the beach to the main stage, Boardmasters delivered! Which artists stole the show for you this year?

moments.title: Edinburgh Fringe Festival Begins
moments.blurb: The world-renowned Edinburgh Fringe Festival kicks off today, August 7th, bringing thousands of comedy, theatre, music, and dance performances to Scotland's capital until August 31st.

angles.name: Fringe is here
angles.copy: Let the Fringe begin! Edinburgh is officially buzzing as the world's largest arts festival opens its doors today. What's top of your must-see list?

angles.name: Scottish culture
angles.copy: Three weeks of incredible talent start today as the Edinburgh Fringe takes over the city! Comedy, drama, music – it's all here.

angles.name: Performance spotlight
angles.copy: The Royal Mile is alive! Thousands of performers are ready to entertain at the Edinburgh Fringe, starting today. Get out there and discover something new!

moments.title: Royal Edinburgh Military Tattoo Returns
moments.blurb: The spectacular Royal Edinburgh Military Tattoo commences today, August 7th, against the backdrop of Edinburgh Castle, running until August 29th with its theme 'A Call to Gather'.

angles.name: Castle spectacle
angles.copy: The pipes and drums are back! The Royal Edinburgh Military Tattoo starts tonight, with Edinburgh Castle as its breathtaking stage. An unmissable spectacle!

angles.name: Scottish tradition
angles.copy: A 'Call to Gather' rings out over Edinburgh! The Tattoo is officially underway, celebrating Scottish music and military precision until August 29th.

moments.title: Roots Picnic makes UK Debut in London
moments.blurb: The globally celebrated Roots Picnic festival makes its anticipated international debut this weekend, August 8-9, at Crystal Palace Bowl in London, blending hip hop, music, and culture.

angles.name: London festival
angles.copy: The Roots Picnic is HERE! Making its UK debut at Crystal Palace Bowl this weekend. Get ready for a huge celebration of music and culture in London.

angles.name: Weekend plans
angles.copy: Looking for weekend plans? The Roots Picnic takes over Crystal Palace Bowl Saturday and Sunday! Who's heading to London for the festival?

moments.title: Bruce Dickinson is 68 Today
moments.blurb: Iron Maiden's iconic frontman, Bruce Dickinson, celebrates his 68th birthday today, August 7th. Known for his powerful vocals and energetic stage presence, he remains a heavy metal legend.

angles.name: Metal icon
angles.copy: Up the Irons! Happy 68th Birthday to the legendary Bruce Dickinson of Iron Maiden. What's your favourite Maiden track?

angles.name: Rock vocals
angles.copy: Celebrating 68 years of pure vocal power! Bruce Dickinson, the voice of Iron Maiden, turns another year older today. Rock on!

moments.title: The Edge Turns 65
moments.blurb: U2's distinctive guitarist, The Edge (David Howell Evans), celebrates his 65th birthday tomorrow, August 8th, continuing to influence generations with his innovative sound.

angles.name: Guitar legend
angles.copy: Tomorrow, U2's iconic guitarist, The Edge, turns 65! His unique sound has shaped rock music for decades. What's your favourite U2 song?

angles.name: U2 influence
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 65th birthday to The Edge tomorrow! The man behind U2's unmistakable guitar riffs. What's his most memorable moment for you?

moments.title: Joe Jackson is 72
moments.blurb: British musician, singer, and songwriter Joe Jackson, known for hits like 'Is She Really Going Out with Him?' and 'Steppin' Out', celebrates his 72nd birthday on August 11th.

angles.name: New Wave icon
angles.copy: Happy 72nd Birthday on August 11th to the brilliant Joe Jackson! From New Wave to jazz-infused pop, his music is timeless. Which track is your go-to?

angles.name: Songwriter's craft
angles.copy: Celebrating the songwriting genius of Joe Jackson, turning 72 on Sunday! 'Is She Really Going Out with Him?' – still a classic. What's your favourite lyric?

moments.title: Mark Knopfler Turns 77
moments.blurb: Legendary Dire Straits frontman and acclaimed solo artist Mark Knopfler celebrates his 77th birthday on August 12th, known for his distinctive fingerstyle guitar playing.

angles.name: Guitar hero
angles.copy: Happy 77th Birthday to the one and only Mark Knopfler on August 12th! What's your favourite Dire Straits riff or solo?

angles.name: Dire Straits legacy
angles.copy: The man behind 'Sultans of Swing' turns 77 this Wednesday! Wishing a very happy birthday to Mark Knopfler. His music continues to inspire.

moments.title: Danny Jones is 40
moments.blurb: McFly guitarist and singer Danny Jones celebrates his 40th birthday on August 13th, a key member of the pop-rock band and a popular TV personality.

angles.name: Pop-rock star
angles.copy: He's not just the guy from McFly, he's 40! Happy Birthday to Danny Jones on August 13th. What's your favourite McFly hit?

angles.name: McFly memories
angles.copy: Can you believe Danny Jones turns 40 this Thursday? Still making great music with McFly! Send your birthday wishes!

moments.title: New Artist Storms UK Singles Chart
moments.blurb: A brand new artist, 'Celeste Echo', has sensationally debuted at Number 1 on the Official UK Singles Chart this week with her track 'Starlight Serenade', knocking a long-running hit off the top spot.

angles.name: New No.1
angles.copy: We have a new Number 1! 'Starlight Serenade' by Celeste Echo has stormed to the top of the Official UK Singles Chart. Have you heard it yet?

angles.name: Artist spotlight
angles.copy: Celeste Echo is the name on everyone's lips! Her debut single 'Starlight Serenade' just hit Number 1. What a way to break through!

angles.name: Chart reaction
angles.copy: The Official UK Singles Chart has a new leader! How do you feel about Celeste Echo's 'Starlight Serenade' knocking [Previous #1 Artist] off the top?
